stylePrefix: Original game art for Naija Street Life, a 2D Nigerian street-life game. STYLE: hand-painted gouache and watercolour texture with confident dark brown-black ink outlines, muted earthy slightly desaturated palette with warm accents, weathered and lived-in contemporary Lagos, soft painted shading lit from the top-left. Match the painting style, palette and line quality of the reference image if one is attached, but do NOT copy its composition.
styleSuffix: No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no border, no UI.

assets.name: tex-ground-dirt
assets.prompt: A SEAMLESS TILEABLE square ground texture seen from DIRECTLY ABOVE (orthographic top view, no perspective, no horizon): dusty brown Lagos street dirt mixed with patches of red laterite soil, small pebbles, faint footprints and tyre marks, a few tiny scraps of litter. Even lighting, no cast shadows, no objects, no plants. Edges must tile seamlessly.

assets.name: tex-ground-grass
assets.prompt: A SEAMLESS TILEABLE square ground texture seen from DIRECTLY ABOVE (orthographic top view): patchy tropical roadside grass, sage and olive greens with dry yellow tufts and bits of red earth showing through. Even lighting, no cast shadows, no objects. Edges must tile seamlessly.

assets.name: tex-ground-asphalt
assets.prompt: A SEAMLESS TILEABLE square texture of worn grey asphalt road seen from DIRECTLY ABOVE (orthographic top view): cracks, darker tar patches, dust, oil stains, NO lane markings and NO potholes. Even lighting, no cast shadows, no objects. Edges must tile seamlessly.

assets.name: tex-ground-interlock
assets.prompt: A SEAMLESS TILEABLE square texture of interlocking concrete paving stones seen from DIRECTLY ABOVE (orthographic top view): beige and grey worn pavers in a regular running pattern, dusty joints, a few cracked or sunken stones, red dust. Even lighting, no cast shadows, no objects. Edges must tile seamlessly.

assets.name: bld-canteen
assets.prompt: ONE isolated building sprite on a fully transparent background. CAMERA: high top-down three-quarter view looking straight down the screen (NOT isometric, NOT rotated): the building is perfectly axis-aligned with its long front wall parallel to the bottom edge of the image and facing the viewer, the rusty corrugated zinc roof seen from above takes the upper two thirds, a short strip of the front wall shows below it. SUBJECT: a small one-storey Lagos mama-put canteen with faded orange plaster, an open serving window with big pots and coolers, a plain blank signboard over the door, burglar-proof window bars, a bench in front. No ground, no grass, no people, no cast shadow on the ground.

assets.name: prop-sheet-street
assets.prompt: A sprite sheet of SIX separate isolated street props on a fully transparent background, arranged in a strict 3 columns by 2 rows grid with wide empty gaps between them, each prop centred in its own cell and fully inside it. CAMERA for every prop: high top-down three-quarter view (seen from above at about 60 degrees, front facing the viewer, not isometric). Top row: (1) a big striped kerbside umbrella over a small wooden table with a POS card machine, (2) a small red petrol generator with a yellow fuel tank, (3) a blue metal container kiosk shop with snacks and recharge cards. Bottom row: (4) a stack of four old car tyres, (5) a blue plastic water drum next to two stacked white plastic chairs, (6) a hawker's wooden tray of oranges on a stand. No ground, no people, no cast shadows.

assets.name: prop-sheet-trees
assets.prompt: A sprite sheet of THREE separate isolated plants/poles on a fully transparent background, in a strict 3 columns by 1 row layout with wide empty gaps, each centred in its own cell and fully inside it. CAMERA: high top-down three-quarter view (seen from above at about 60 degrees, not isometric). (1) a large leafy mango shade tree with a round dense canopy and some mangoes, short trunk visible at the bottom, (2) a tall coconut palm with fronds seen from above and the curved trunk, (3) a tall wooden electricity pole with a crossbar, porcelain insulators and a grey transformer box. No ground, no shadows, no wires leaving the cell.

assets.name: veh-danfo-top
assets.prompt: ONE isolated vehicle sprite on a fully transparent background: a yellow Lagos danfo minibus (Toyota HiAce style) with two black stripes along the sides, a luggage rack on the roof, seen from DIRECTLY ABOVE (true top-down view, roof facing the camera), the front of the bus pointing to the RIGHT edge of the image, centred and horizontal, slight hint of the side panels and wheels. Weathered and dented. No ground, no shadow, no people outside.

assets.name: chr-tunde-walk
assets.prompt: A character WALK-CYCLE sprite sheet on a fully transparent background, a strict grid of 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 frames of the SAME character, each full body centred in its own equal cell with empty gaps, same size and same feet baseline in every cell. CHARACTER: Tunde, a wiry 34-year-old Nigerian danfo driver with dark brown skin, short black hair, a faded red football jersey, dark trousers, sandals and a white towel over one shoulder; chunky charming proportions with a large head (about one third of body height), small body, as seen from a high top-down three-quarter camera (from above at about 60 degrees). Row 1: four frames walking DOWN toward the viewer (left foot, passing, right foot, passing). Row 2: four frames walking UP away from the viewer. Row 3: four frames walking to the RIGHT in side view. The legs must visibly alternate. No ground, no shadows, no labels.

assets.name: chr-pedestrians-a
assets.prompt: A sprite sheet on a fully transparent background, a strict grid of 4 columns by 2 rows, EIGHT DIFFERENT ordinary Lagos pedestrians, one full-body person per cell, each standing facing down toward the viewer, centred with empty gaps, same scale and feet baseline. Chunky charming proportions with large heads (about one third of body height), seen from a high top-down three-quarter camera. Mix: a market woman in ankara wrapper and gele carrying a basin on her head, a student in school uniform with a backpack, a man in a kaftan and cap, an okada rider in a helmet holding it, an older man in agbada, a young woman in jeans and a T-shirt with a phone, a hawker with a tray of bread on his head, a security guard in uniform. No ground, no shadows, no labels.

assets.name: chr-pedestrians-b

Chunky charming proportions with large heads (about one third of body height), seen from a high top-down three-quarter camera. Mix: a woman in a blue ankara dress, a teenage boy in a football jersey, a man in a white shirt and tie with a briefcase, a woman with a baby tied on her back, a man pushing nothing but carrying a sack, an old woman with a walking stick, a young man in a hoodie, a woman carrying a bowl of pure-water sachets on her head.
